items.question: Do you work with small brands or only large companies?
items.answer: We work with companies of all sizes, from different categories. Focusing efforts on the current situation and the goals of each brand.

items.question: How long does the process take?
items.answer: The process can take between 4 and 8 weeks, depending on the depth of each stage of the project.

items.question: Do you work with companies outside Colombia?
items.answer: Yes, we work with companies from anywhere in the world.

items.question: Do you work per project or ongoing?
items.answer: We can work in both models. Usually projects become ongoing brand support.

items.question: Do you deliver editable files for printing?
items.answer: Yes, we deliver final artwork with all technical specifications for production.
